mapper.select: SELECT pf.authorize_workspace_actor(#{actor.userId},#{actor.spaceId}) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.space s WHERE s.id=#{actor.spaceId} AND s.owner_user_id=#{actor.userId} AND s.type='PERSONAL')
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.workspace w WHERE w.id=#{workspace} AND w.space_id=#{actor.spaceId} AND w.actor_id=#{actor.userId})
SELECT action,request_hash,memory_id,result_revision FROM pf.memory_mutation_request WHERE space_id=#{actor.spaceId} AND actor_id=#{actor.userId} AND request_id=#{request}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pf.personal_memory(id,space_id,owner_user_id,scope_kind,workspace_id,category,topic_key,content,content_sha256,source_kind,status,expires_at) VALUES(#{input.id},#{input.actor.spaceId},#{input.actor.userId},#{input.scope},#{input.workspace},#{input.category},#{input.topic},#{input.content},#{input.contentHash},'USER_PROVIDED','PENDING', clock_timestamp()+CASE #{input.category} WHEN 'PREFERENCE' THEN interval '180 days' WHEN 'PROCEDURE' THEN interval '90 days' ELSE interval '30 days' END)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM pf.personal_memory WHERE id=#{id} AND space_id=#{actor.spaceId} AND owner_user_id=#{actor.userId} AND pf.authorize_workspace_actor(#{actor.userId},#{actor.spaceId})
SELECT * FROM pf.personal_memory WHERE id=#{id} AND space_id=#{actor.spaceId} AND owner_user_id=#{actor.userId} AND pf.authorize_workspace_actor(#{actor.userId},#{actor.spaceId}) FOR UPDATE

SELECT * FROM pf.personal_memory WHERE space_id=#{actor.spaceId} AND owner_user_id=#{actor.userId} AND status='ACTIVE' AND expires_at>clock_timestamp() AND (scope_kind='PERSONAL' OR workspace_id=#{workspace}) AND (workspace_id IS NULL OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.workspace w WHERE w.id=personal_memory.workspace_id AND w.space_id=personal_memory.space_id AND w.actor_id=#{actor.userId})) AND pf.authorize_workspace_actor(#{actor.userId},#{actor.spaceId}) ORDER BY updated_at DESC,id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: WITH changed AS ( UPDATE pf.personal_memory SET status=CASE WHEN category IN('PREFERENCE','PROCEDURE') THEN 'REVIEW_REQUIRED' ELSE 'EXPIRED' END, revision=revision+1,updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE space_id=#{actor.spaceId} AND owner_user_id=#{actor.userId} AND status='ACTIVE' AND expires_at<=clock_timestamp() AND pf.authorize_workspace_actor(#{actor.userId},#{actor.spaceId}) RETURNING id,space_id,owner_user_id,category,revision,content_sha256 ) INSERT INTO pf.personal_memory_audit(id,space_id,owner_user_id,memory_id,action,revision,content_sha256) SELECT gen_random_uuid(),space_id,owner_user_id,id,CASE WHEN category IN('PREFERENCE','PROCEDURE') THEN 'REVIEW' ELSE 'EXPIRE' END,revision,content_sha256 FROM changed
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM pf.personal_memory WHERE space_id=#{actor.spaceId} AND owner_user_id=#{actor.userId} AND status='ACTIVE' AND scope_kind=#{target.scopeKind} AND workspace_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM #{target.workspaceId} AND topic_key=#{target.topicKey} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE pf.personal_memory SET status='ACTIVE',confirmed_at=clock_timestamp(),revision=revision+1,updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE id=#{id} AND space_id=#{actor.spaceId} AND owner_user_id=#{actor.userId} AND revision=#{revision} AND status='PENDING' AND expires_at>clock_timestamp()

UPDATE pf.personal_memory SET status=#{to},confirmed_at=NULL,revision=revision+1,updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE id=#{id} AND space_id=#{actor.spaceId} AND owner_user_id=#{actor.userId} AND revision=#{revision} AND status=#{from}

UPDATE pf.personal_memory SET category=COALESCE(#{category},category),topic_key=COALESCE(#{topic},topic_key),content=#{content},content_sha256=#{hash}, expires_at=clock_timestamp()+CASE COALESCE(#{category},category) WHEN 'PREFERENCE' THEN interval '180 days' WHEN 'PROCEDURE' THEN interval '90 days' ELSE interval '30 days' END, revision=revision+1,updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE id=#{id} AND space_id=#{actor.spaceId} AND owner_user_id=#{actor.userId} AND revision=#{revision} AND status IN('PENDING','ACTIVE')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pf.personal_memory_audit(id,space_id,owner_user_id,memory_id,action,revision,content_sha256) SELECT #{id},#{actor.spaceId},#{actor.userId},id,#{action},#{revision},#{hash} FROM pf.personal_memory WHERE id=#{memory} AND space_id=#{actor.spaceId} AND owner_user_id=#{actor.userId}
